findings.title: Check-then-open race can overwrite an existing file
findings.evidence: The new logic checks existence and then opens with write mode, so another process or thread can create the same path after the check but before the open; in that case open with w will truncate the file instead of raising FileExistsError.
findings.recommendation: Restore atomic exclusive creation by using open(path, 'x') directly, or use a lower-level atomic create such as os.open with O_CREAT|O_EXCL and then wrap the file descriptor.
